title: Event
description: A dated occurrence relevant to an investigation. Events are the atomic units of timelines. An event record asserts only that something occurred and when; the CHARACTERISATION of an event (who ordered it, what it meant, whether it was lawful) must be expressed as Claims with evidence, not embedded in the event description. Where the occurrence of the event is itself contested, a Claim asserting the event must exist and the event's claim_ids must reference it.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:event:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

title.description: Brief descriptive title for the event.

description.description: Description of what occurred. Should be based on documented evidence, not assertion.

date.description: Date the event occurred. Use the most precise date available.

date_notes.description: Notes on date uncertainty or how the date was determined.

claim_ids.description: Claims that assert or contest the nature of this event.

person_ids.description: People who were involved in or present at this event.

organisation_ids.description: Organisations involved in or responsible for this event.
